description: He wears a dark navy knee-length wool tunic with fine tan-gold woven borders and a cream linen shirt at the collar and wrists. A navy shoulder mantle with matching borders fastens at the right shoulder with a round brooch and drapes across the chest; a decorated leather belt has round metal fittings and a hanging woven end. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
